m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: So Nalia Dunestrider will be gracing us with her presence, will she?
I applaud you for your sportsmanship. If she had not shown up for the duel, you would have won by default.
Go to the Hall of the Specter and show her what you're worth, and return to me when the duel is completed.
You just might take the prize! I'm watching the standings of all the other competitors, and you're one of the few unbeaten Wizards!
I trust Headmistress Crisp has more business with you... business concerning the recovery of the Spiral Cup!
I'm astonished. You're doing quite well.  Would that Wizard City had seen fit to compete these past few years...
Now that I've got my wand, I'm ready to duel. You should go tell Master Glendemming that I'll be there shortly.
I'll see you in the Tournament Hall, in the Hall of the Specter!
Head to the Tournament Hall to speak with Benedict Glendemming. Tell him I'll meet you in the Hall of the Specter!
